caption: The drawing depicts a decorative arrangement of fruit and leaves set in a pale, ceramic pedestal bowl with a rounded base. The arrangement primarily features large, yellowish-green fruits with small, dotted spots, likely intended to represent pineapples or similar fruits, situated towards the top section. Red and green round fruits, resembling apples or pomegranates, are positioned among the larger yellowish-green fruits and throughout the composition. Interspersed between the fruits are numerous elongated, pointed green leaves, which have visible venation and provide a backdrop and border for the fruit. The overall composition is symmetrical, with foliage and fruit radiating outward and upward from the bowl. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, with some natural color variations and light marks. The artist's name, “INEZ Mc COMB,” appears written in small letters near the base of the bowl on the lower right side.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Mantel Ornament
